mapper.select: select 'CUSTOMER_RATING_COVERAGE' as check_code, '有效客户评级覆盖' as check_name, 'HIGH' as severity, count(c.id) as record_total, ifnull(sum(r.id is null), 0) as issue_count from corporate_customer c left join corporate_rating r on r.active_customer_no = c.customer_no where c.deleted_flag = 0 union all select 'CUSTOMER_LIMIT_COVERAGE', '有效客户额度覆盖', 'HIGH', count(c.id), ifnull(sum(l.id is null), 0) from corporate_customer c left join corporate_credit_limit l on l.active_customer_no = c.customer_no where c.deleted_flag = 0 union all select 'CONTRACT_APPLICATION_RELATION', '合同申请关联完整性', 'CRITICAL', count(c.id), ifnull(sum(a.id is null), 0) from corporate_credit_contract c left join corporate_credit_application a on a.application_no = c.application_no_snapshot and a.deleted_flag = 0 where c.deleted_flag = 0 union all select 'DRAWDOWN_CONTRACT_RELATION', '支用合同关联完整性', 'CRITICAL', count(d.id), ifnull(sum(c.id is null), 0) from corporate_credit_drawdown d left join corporate_credit_contract c on c.contract_no = d.contract_no_snapshot and c.deleted_flag = 0 where d.deleted_flag = 0 union all select 'EXPOSURE_DRAWDOWN_RELATION', '风险敞口支用关联完整性', 'HIGH', count(e.id), ifnull(sum(d.id is null), 0) from corporate_risk_exposure e left join corporate_credit_drawdown d on d.drawdown_no = e.drawdown_no and d.deleted_flag = 0 where e.deleted_flag = 0 and e.drawdown_no is not null union all select 'COLLATERAL_CONTRACT_RELATION', '合同押品关联完整性', 'MEDIUM', count(r.id), ifnull(sum(c.id is null or p.id is null), 0) from corporate_credit_contract_collateral r left join corporate_credit_contract c on c.contract_no = r.contract_no and c.deleted_flag = 0 left join corporate_credit_collateral p on p.collateral_no = r.collateral_no and p.deleted_flag = 0 where r.deleted_flag = 0 union all select 'OVERDUE_DEBT_REFERENCE', '逾期债项引用完整性', 'HIGH', count(o.id), ifnull(sum(d.id is null), 0) from corporate_credit_overdue o left join corporate_credit_drawdown d on d.debt_no = o.debt_no and d.deleted_flag = 0 where o.deleted_flag = 0 union all select 'DEFAULT_CUSTOMER_REFERENCE', '违约客户引用完整性', 'CRITICAL', count(d.id), ifnull(sum(c.id is null), 0) from corporate_debt_default d left join corporate_customer c on c.customer_no = d.customer_no and c.deleted_flag = 0 where d.deleted_flag = 0
select domain_name, entity_name, source_table, business_key, key_fields, freshness_sla_hours, sensitivity_level, enabled, updated_at from risk_data_lineage where enabled = 1 order by domain_name, id

select snapshot_date, quality_score, check_total, pass_count, warning_count, failed_count, issue_total, detail_json, captured_at from risk_data_quality_snapshot order by snapshot_date desc, id desc limit 1

select count(*) as batch_total, ifnull(sum(batch_status = 'SUCCESS'), 0) as success_count, ifnull(sum(batch_status = 'WARNING'), 0) as warning_count, ifnull(sum(batch_status = 'FAILED'), 0) as failed_count, ifnull(sum(source_record_count), 0) as source_record_total, ifnull(sum(accepted_record_count), 0) as accepted_record_total, ifnull(sum(rejected_record_count), 0) as rejected_record_total, max(completed_at) as latest_completed_at from risk_data_ingestion_batch

select batch_no, source_system, source_entity, batch_status, source_record_count, accepted_record_count, rejected_record_count, quality_score, started_at, completed_at, operator, remark from risk_data_ingestion_batch order by started_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into risk_data_ingestion_batch (batch_no, source_system, source_entity, batch_status, source_record_count, accepted_record_count, rejected_record_count, quality_score, started_at, completed_at, operator, remark) values (#{batch_no}, #{source_system}, #{source_entity}, #{batch_status}, #{source_record_count}, #{accepted_record_count}, #{rejected_record_count}, #{quality_score}, #{started_at}, #{completed_at}, #{operator}, #{remark})
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from sys_role where status = 'ENABLED') as active_role_count, (select count(*) from sys_permission) as permission_count, (select count(*) from sys_role_permission) as role_permission_count, (select count(*) from sys_user where status = 'ENABLED') as active_user_count, (select count(*) from sys_operation_log where method in ('POST','PUT','DELETE') and created_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day)) as sensitive_operation_7d, (select count(*) from sys_operation_log where status = 'FAILED' and created_at >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day)) as failed_operation_7d

select r.name as role_name, r.code as role_code, count(p.id) as permission_count, group_concat(p.code order by p.module, p.code separator ', ') as permission_codes from sys_role r left join sys_role_permission rp on rp.role_id = r.id left join sys_permission p on p.id = rp.permission_id where r.status = 'ENABLED' group by r.id, r.name, r.code order by permission_count desc, r.id

select username, module, action, method, request_uri, status, created_at from sys_operation_log where method in ('POST','PUT','DELETE') or request_uri like '%/approve%' or request_uri like '%/publish%' or request_uri like '%/rollback%' or request_uri like '%/close%' or request_uri like '%/escalate%' order by id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into risk_data_quality_snapshot (snapshot_date, quality_score, check_total, pass_count, warning_count, failed_count, issue_total, detail_json, captured_at) values (#{snapshot_date}, #{quality_score}, #{check_total}, #{pass_count}, #{warning_count}, #{failed_count}, #{issue_total}, #{detail_json}, #{captured_at}) on duplicate key update quality_score = values(quality_score), check_total = values(check_total), pass_count = values(pass_count), warning_count = values(warning_count), failed_count = values(failed_count), issue_total = values(issue_total), detail_json = values(detail_json), captured_at = values(captured_at)
mapper.select: select id, version_code, version_name, status, baseline_version_id, rule_count, created_by, submitted_by, approved_by, approval_comment, simulation_summary, simulated_at, submitted_at, approved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at from risk_model_version order by id desc limit #{limit}

select id, version_code, version_name, status, baseline_version_id, rule_count, created_by, submitted_by, approved_by, approval_comment, simulation_summary, simulated_at, submitted_at, approved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at from risk_model_version where id = #{id}

select id, version_code, version_name, status, baseline_version_id, rule_count, created_by, submitted_by, approved_by, approval_comment, simulation_summary, simulated_at, submitted_at, approved_at, published_at, created_at, updated_at from risk_model_version where status = 'PUBLISHED' order by published_at desc, id desc limit 1

select id, version_id, rule_code, rule_name, metric_key, operator_type, threshold_value, effect_type, score_value, risk_tag, reason_template, enabled, sort_order, created_at, updated_at from risk_model_version_rule where version_id = #{versionId} order by sort_order, id
select id, version_id, action_type, decision, operator, comment, created_at from risk_model_approval_log where version_id = #{versionId} order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into risk_model_version (version_code, version_name, status, baseline_version_id, rule_count, created_by) values (#{version_code}, #{version_name}, #{status}, #{baseline_version_id}, #{rule_count}, #{created_by})

insert into risk_model_version_rule (version_id, rule_code, rule_name, metric_key, operator_type, threshold_value, effect_type, score_value, risk_tag, reason_template, enabled, sort_order) select #{versionId}, rule_code, rule_name, metric_key, operator_type, threshold_value, effect_type, score_value, risk_tag, reason_template, enabled, sort_order from risk_scoring_rule

insert into risk_scoring_rule (rule_code, rule_name, metric_key, operator_type, threshold_value, effect_type, score_value, risk_tag, reason_template, enabled, sort_order) select rule_code, rule_name, metric_key, operator_type, threshold_value, effect_type, score_value, risk_tag, reason_template, enabled, sort_order from risk_model_version_rule where version_id = #{versionId} on duplicate key update rule_name = values(rule_name), metric_key = values(metric_key), operator_type = values(operator_type), threshold_value = values(threshold_value), effect_type = values(effect_type), score_value = values(score_value), risk_tag = values(risk_tag), reason_template = values(reason_template), enabled = values(enabled), sort_order = values(sort_order)
insert into risk_model_approval_log (version_id, action_type, decision, operator, comment) values (#{version_id}, #{action_type}, #{decision}, #{operator}, #{comment})
mapper.select: select c.id, c.customer_no, c.risk_code, c.priority, c.risk_score, c.alert_state, c.owner, c.sla_due_at, c.escalation_level, c.review_comment, c.reviewed_by, c.reviewed_at, c.first_detected_at, c.last_detected_at, c.started_at, c.closed_at, c.closure_comment, c.updated_at, u.customer_name, u.industry_name, u.owner_org_name, l.id as link_id, l.last_sync_state, l.last_sync_at, p.id as treatment_plan_id, p.plan_code, p.status as treatment_status, p.progress as treatment_progress, p.due_date as treatment_due_date, e.id as risk_event_id, e.status as event_status, i.id as risk_indicator_id, i.current_value as indicator_current_value, i.status as indicator_status from risk_alert_case c left join corporate_customer u on u.customer_no = c.customer_no left join risk_alert_case_link l on l.alert_case_id = c.id left join risk_treatment_plan p on p.id = l.treatment_plan_id left join risk_event e on e.id = l.risk_event_id left join risk_indicator i on i.id = l.risk_indicator_id where c.alert_state = #{state} order by c.alert_state = 'OVERDUE' desc, c.sla_due_at asc, c.risk_score desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from risk_alert_case where alert_state = #{state}

select c.id, c.customer_no, c.risk_code, c.priority, c.risk_score, c.alert_state, c.owner, c.sla_due_at, c.escalation_level, c.review_comment, c.reviewed_by, c.reviewed_at, c.first_detected_at, c.last_detected_at, c.started_at, c.closed_at, c.closure_comment, c.updated_at, u.customer_name, u.industry_name, u.owner_org_name from risk_alert_case c left join corporate_customer u on u.customer_no = c.customer_no where c.customer_no = #{customerNo}

select count(*) as total_count, ifnull(sum(alert_state = 'OPEN'), 0) as open_count, ifnull(sum(alert_state = 'IN_PROGRESS'), 0) as in_progress_count, ifnull(sum(alert_state = 'PENDING_REVIEW'), 0) as pending_review_count, ifnull(sum(alert_state = 'REJECTED'), 0) as rejected_count, ifnull(sum(alert_state = 'OVERDUE'), 0) as overdue_count, ifnull(sum(alert_state = 'RESOLVED'), 0) as resolved_count, ifnull(sum(alert_state in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'OVERDUE') and date(sla_due_at) = current_date), 0) as due_today_count, ifnull(sum(l.id is not null), 0) as linked_count, ifnull(sum(p.status in ('未开始', '进行中', '逾期')), 0) as open_treatment_count from risk_alert_case c left join risk_alert_case_link l on l.alert_case_id = c.id left join risk_treatment_plan p on p.id = l.treatment_plan_id
mapper.insert: insert into risk_alert_case (customer_no, risk_code, priority, risk_score, alert_state, owner, sla_due_at, escalation_level, first_detected_at, last_detected_at) values (#{customer_no}, #{risk_code}, #{priority}, #{risk_score}, #{alert_state}, #{owner}, #{sla_due_at}, 0, #{detected_at}, #{detected_at}) on duplicate key update risk_code = values(risk_code), priority = values(priority), risk_score = values(risk_score), owner = values(owner), alert_state = case when alert_state = 'RESOLVED' and values(risk_score) >= risk_score + 10 then 'OPEN' else alert_state end, sla_due_at = case when alert_state in ('OPEN', 'OVERDUE') then values(sla_due_at) else sla_due_at end, escalation_level = case when alert_state = 'OPEN' then 0 else escalation_level end, closed_at = case when alert_state = 'OPEN' then null else closed_at end, closure_comment = case when alert_state = 'OPEN' then null else closure_comment end, last_detected_at = values(last_detected_at)
mapper.update: update risk_alert_case set alert_state = 'IN_PROGRESS', owner = coalesce(nullif(#{operator}, ''), owner), started_at = coalesce(started_at, #{startedAt}) where customer_no = #{customerNo} and alert_state in ('OPEN', 'OVERDUE', 'REJECTED')

update risk_alert_case set alert_state = #{state}, owner = coalesce(nullif(owner, ''), #{operator}), review_comment = #{comment}, reviewed_by = case when #{state} in ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED') then #{operator} else reviewed_by end, reviewed_at = case when #{state} in ('RESOLVED', 'REJECTED') then #{operatedAt} else reviewed_at end, closed_at = case when #{state} = 'RESOLVED' then #{operatedAt} else closed_at end, closure_comment = case when #{state} = 'RESOLVED' then #{comment} else closure_comment end where customer_no = #{customerNo} and ( (#{state} = 'PENDING_REVIEW' and alert_state in ('IN_PROGRESS', 'OVERDUE', 'REJECTED')) or (#{state} = 'RESOLVED' and alert_state = 'PENDING_REVIEW') or (#{state} = 'REJECTED' and alert_state = 'PENDING_REVIEW') )

update risk_alert_case set alert_state = 'OVERDUE', escalation_level = least(escalation_level + 1, 3), review_comment = #{comment}, owner = coalesce(nullif(owner, ''), #{operator}) where customer_no = #{customerNo} and alert_state in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'PENDING_REVIEW', 'REJECTED', 'OVERDUE')
mapper.insert: insert into risk_alert_case_timeline(customer_no, action_type, from_state, to_state, operator, comment, created_at) values (#{customer_no}, #{action_type}, #{from_state}, #{to_state}, #{operator}, #{comment}, #{created_at})
mapper.select: select customer_no, action_type, from_state, to_state, operator, comment, created_at from risk_alert_case_timeline where customer_no = #{customerNo} order by id desc limit 50

select c.id, c.customer_no, c.risk_code, c.priority, c.risk_score, c.alert_state, c.owner, c.sla_due_at, c.escalation_level, c.first_detected_at, c.last_detected_at, c.started_at, c.closed_at, c.closure_comment, c.updated_at, u.customer_name, u.industry_name, u.owner_org_name from risk_alert_case c left join corporate_customer u on u.customer_no = c.customer_no where c.alert_state in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'OVERDUE', 'RESOLVED') order by c.id
select id, risk_code, risk_name, category, `level`, owner_department, responsible_person, status, identified_at, due_date, description from risk_register where risk_code = #{riskCode} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into risk_register (risk_code, risk_name, category, `level`, owner_department, responsible_person, status, identified_at, due_date, description) values (#{risk_code}, #{risk_name}, #{category}, #{level}, #{owner_department}, #{responsible_person}, #{status}, #{identified_at}, #{due_date}, #{description})
mapper.select: select id, plan_code, risk_code, action, owner, due_date, progress, status from risk_treatment_plan where risk_code = #{riskCode} order by id desc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into risk_treatment_plan (plan_code, risk_code, action, owner, due_date, progress, status) values (#{plan_code}, #{risk_code}, #{action}, #{owner}, #{due_date}, #{progress}, #{status})
mapper.select: select id, event_code, title, risk_code, severity, occurred_at, loss_amount, owner, status, summary from risk_event where event_code = #{eventCode} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into risk_event (event_code, title, risk_code, severity, occurred_at, loss_amount, owner, status, summary) values (#{event_code}, #{title}, #{risk_code}, #{severity}, #{occurred_at}, #{loss_amount}, #{owner}, #{status}, #{summary})
mapper.select: select id, indicator_code, name, threshold_value, current_value, trend, owner, status from risk_indicator where indicator_code = #{indicatorCode} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into risk_indicator (indicator_code, name, threshold_value, current_value, trend, owner, status) values (#{indicator_code}, #{name}, #{threshold_value}, #{current_value}, #{trend}, #{owner}, #{status})

insert into risk_alert_case_link (alert_case_id, risk_code, treatment_plan_id, risk_event_id, risk_indicator_id, last_sync_state, last_sync_at) values (#{alert_case_id}, #{risk_code}, #{treatment_plan_id}, #{risk_event_id}, #{risk_indicator_id}, #{last_sync_state}, #{last_sync_at}) on duplicate key update risk_code = values(risk_code), treatment_plan_id = values(treatment_plan_id), risk_event_id = values(risk_event_id), risk_indicator_id = values(risk_indicator_id), last_sync_state = values(last_sync_state), last_sync_at = values(last_sync_at)
insert into risk_stress_test_run (scenario_code, scenario_name, parameter_json, summary_json, run_by) values (#{scenario_code}, #{scenario_name}, #{parameter_json}, #{summary_json}, #{run_by})
mapper.select: select id, scenario_code, scenario_name, parameter_json, summary_json, run_by, created_at from risk_stress_test_run order by id desc limit #{limit}

select contract_no, product_type, contract_amount, contract_status, sign_date, expiry_date from corporate_credit_contract where customer_no_snapshot = #{customerNo} and deleted_flag = 0 order by sign_date desc, id desc limit 12

select drawdown_no, debt_no, contract_no_snapshot as contract_no, product_type, actual_draw_amount, outstanding_principal_amount, risk_level as drawdown_risk_level from corporate_credit_drawdown where customer_no_snapshot = #{customerNo} and deleted_flag = 0 order by drawdown_date desc, id desc limit 20

select r.contract_no, p.collateral_no, p.collateral_type, p.confirmed_value, r.secured_amount, r.relation_status from corporate_credit_contract_collateral r join corporate_credit_collateral p on p.collateral_no = r.collateral_no and p.deleted_flag = 0 where r.customer_no = #{customerNo} and r.deleted_flag = 0 order by r.contract_no, p.collateral_no limit 20

select customer_no, customer_name, industry_name, owner_org_name, relationship_manager_name from corporate_customer where deleted_flag = 0 and relationship_manager_name = ( select relationship_manager_name from corporate_customer where customer_no = #{customerNo} limit 1 ) and customer_no != #{customerNo} order by customer_no limit 8
